subject: RM_LiquidPump (Modern style)

verdicts.notes: Recognisable modern pump treatment. The casing, motor and connections remain distinct at play zoom. Deliberate top-down view is appropriate here.
Modern materials and four-port registration work, but the product identity is wrong for this subject.
verdicts.seen: The dominant transparent window exposes a perforated basket. The object reads as an inline basket strainer rather than a liquid pump; no identifiable motor or switch establishes the requested product.
verdicts.redo_brief: Replace the dominant basket window with an identifiable composite pump housing, motor and pressure switch, preserving the four centred port endpoints.
verdicts.quote: Each Modern picture is recognisably one real product class listed below (a poly storage tank, an IBC tote, a resin hose-reel cart …).

verdicts.notes: The stainless clamp connections and blue housing otherwise communicate modern materials, and the required plan-view port arrangement is preserved.
verdicts.seen: Four prominent silver bolt heads secure the blue circular face cover, making a bolted end-cap a major visible feature.
verdicts.redo_brief: Replace the bolted blue face cover with a smooth moulded motor housing while preserving the stainless clamp connections and all four port endpoints.
verdicts.quote: Rivets, weld seams, rust, hazard stripes and bolted end-caps belong to the other looks.

verdicts.notes: pass 2 after redraw: The redraw establishes a motor and reads as a composite utility pump, resolving the basket-strainer concern. Main shapes remain distinct at play zoom.
pass 2 after redraw: The blue face now reads as a motor fan guard rather than a bolted cover. Stainless and blue motor remain distinct at play zoom; modern form extends beyond colour.

scope: drafts for the owner's pick only; replaces kept art (E3, delegation_policy §2.3), nothing installed
